How Network Packets Travel

When you type a domain like example.com into your web browser, information is split into small pieces called Packets.

1. DNS Lookup Translates domain names into IP addresses so packets know where to navigate.
2. TCP Handshake Establishes a reliable connection between client and server (SYN → SYN-ACK → ACK).
3. HTTP Data Transfer Requests web content and receives fragmented payloads that reassemble at the destination.
4. Packet Loss & Routers Intermediate routers forward packets. If congestion occurs, packets are dropped and retransmitted.
